generator.label: QR code generator
generator.chooseType: What should your QR code do?
generator.placeholder: Your QR code will appear here
generator.dense: This is a lot of data, so the code will be dense and harder to scan. Tip: {tip}.
generator.tooLong: Too much data for one QR code. Please shorten it.
generator.fixErrors: Fill in the highlighted fields to see your code.

url.url: We add https:// if you leave it out.

wifi.password: Spaces count, so type it exactly as it is.

upi.am: Leave empty to let the payer enter any amount.

whatsapp.number: Type the number without the country code, or include it with +.

phone.number: Type the number without the country code, or include it with +.

sms.number: Type the number without the country code, or include it with +.

location.mapsLink: We pull the coordinates out of the link. Or type them below.
location.format: Google Maps links open on almost every phone; geo: opens the phone's default map app.

event.timezone: The time is converted for people in other time zones.

social.username: @name, name, or the full profile link all work.

review.url: In Google Business Profile, choose “Ask for reviews” and copy the link. Short g.page links work too.

appstore.store: A QR code can hold one link. Choose which store to send people to.

crypto.amount: Optional. In BTC or ETH, not in rupees or dollars.

url.invalid: This doesn't look like a web address. Try something like example.com/menu.
url.scheme: Only http:// and https:// links are allowed.

phone.invalid: Please enter a valid phone number.
phone.countryCode: Choose a country code, or type the number with +.

email.invalid: Please enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.

wifi.ssidLength: Network names can be at most 32 bytes long.
wifi.wpaLength: WPA passwords are 8 to 63 characters long.

upi.vpa: UPI ID should look like name@bank.
upi.amount: Enter an amount like 150 or 99.50 — no commas or ₹ sign.
upi.noteLength: Keep the note to 80 characters or fewer.

vcard.name: Enter a first or last name.

location.required: Paste a Google Maps link or enter coordinates.

event.start: Please enter a valid start date.
event.end: Please enter a valid end date.
event.order: The end must be after the start.

social.username: Usernames can only use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.

crypto.address: This doesn't look like a valid wallet address for this currency.
crypto.chainId: Chain ID must be a whole number.

errors.tooLong: Too much data for one QR code. Please shorten it.

image.unreadable: We couldn't read that image. Try a PNG, JPG or WebP file.
image.noCode: We couldn't find a QR code in this image. Try a sharper, closer photo.

logo.type: Please choose a PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP image.
logo.size: That image is too large. Please use one under 5 MB.

errors.export: Something went wrong while creating the file. Please try again.

templates.file: This isn't a PakkaQR designs file.

errors.clipboard: Your browser didn't allow copying. Try downloading instead.

location.noCoords: We couldn't find coordinates in this link (short links hide them), so the code will hold the link itself.

appstore.host: This isn't a Google Play or App Store link. It will still work as a normal link.

review.host: This doesn't look like a Google review link. It will still work as a normal link.

upi.check: Always check the payee name in your UPI app before paying.

design.transparentHint: PNG and SVG only. Place it on a light background.
design.marginHint: White space around the code, in modules. 4 is recommended.
design.ecHint: Higher levels survive damage and logos better, but make the code denser.

logo.drop: Drag and drop, paste, or click to choose an image

export.heading: Download
export.promise: Works forever · No tracking · No watermark
export.svgTip: SVG stays sharp at any size — best for printing.

status.risky: This code might be hard to scan. {reason}
status.label: Scan check

reason.inverted: Light code on dark background — some cameras struggle.
reason.quietZone: Add more white space around the code.
reason.density: Too much data for a small print — shorten it, or print it at least {cm} cm wide.
reason.decode: Our test scanner couldn't read it.

notScannable.title: This code may not scan
notScannable.body: Our test couldn't read this code reliably. People might not be able to scan it.

toast.saved: Saved! This code will work forever.
toast.support: PakkaQR is free forever. If it helped, star us on GitHub or buy us a coffee.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.enter: In a field: jump to Download

saved.title: My designs & history
saved.intro: Saved designs and history stay in this browser only. Nothing is uploaded.
saved.name: Design name
saved.includeContent: Also save the content (not just the style)
saved.historyNote: Off by default. Stored only on this device.
saved.historyEmpty: Nothing here yet. Codes you download will appear here.
saved.shareLinkCopied: Style link copied. It holds your style only — never your content.
saved.shareLinkNote: Share your look with others. The link holds the style only, never your content or logo.
saved.appliedFromLink: We applied the style from the link you opened.

install.prompt: Install PakkaQR? It works offline, too.
